  "memo":"R03 holds because the card issuing and IP countries differ and CVV failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, and household exceptions are unnecessary. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no check has run. Recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. Contact is not required. A legitimate foreign-issued card with an incorrectly entered security code remains plausible, particularly given the established device, home delivery and passing AVS. Those facts do not establish card ownership. The order is unshipped, so verification can precede fulfilment."
